mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId}) = 0 THEN '연동 주문 상품' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId}) = 1 THEN (SELECT product_name FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1) ELSE CONCAT((SELECT product_name FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1), ' 외 ', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId}) - 1, '건') END
